HR & Payroll for Sri Lankan SMEs—
Fast, Compliant, Customisable

Automate attendance, leave and payroll with EPF/ETF/APIT built-in. Configure approvals, payslips, bank files and reports to match your flow—then lock month-end with audit-ready packs.

Problem

Spreadsheets, missing punches and late approvals trigger payroll errors and penalties.

Agitation

Late/OT disputes, mismatched EPF/ETF/APIT, auditor requests derail month-end.

Solution

One flow—biometrics to payroll—with your rules, approvals and audit reports built in.

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

  • Payroll in minutes with EPF/ETF/APIT and stamp duty auto-calculated.

CORE MODULES

Attendance & Biometrics

Integrate fingerprint/face devices or use web/CSV/Excel; process raw logs to registers. Auto rules: late, early-out, half-day, no-pay, OT windows/rounding/grace; exception queue & approvals.

Employee-wise views; department/branch/worker-type registers.

Leave Management

Configurable leave types, accruals/proration, carry-forward/encashment, docs; multi-level approvals; blackout dates.

Leave periods, holidays, late/short-leave caps. Real-time balances & histories with self-service.

Map my leave policy

Payroll & Payslips

EPF/ETF/APIT, PAYE, stamp duty; recurring + one-time items; loans/advances/off-cycle.Bilingual payslips and bulk e-payslip delivery with secure templates/password rules.

IMPLEMENTATION & CHANGE MANAGEMENT

Fit-Assessment → Prototype (1–2 weeks) with sample data → UAT & sign-off → Migration (masters, YTD, balances, history) → Go-Live (optional parallel run; period lock) → Post-Go (30–60–90 day tune-ups; L1/L2/L3 under SLA).

REAL-WORLD SCENARIOS

Apparel (multi-shift):

night OT 1.5x after 22:00; meal allowance if OT > 2h; Sinhala payslip.

Retail (rosters):

weekend premium; dual approval for store managers; auto no-pay after late threshold.

Services (field):

geo-tag web clock-ins; travel/day-allowance slabs; project-wise cost exports.

Education (terms):

proration for mid-term joiners; adjunct elements; tenure-based leave caps.

SECURITY & RELIABILITY

RBAC with audit trails; encryption in transit/at rest; daily backups; optional IP restrictions & 2FA; Huawei Cloud hosting with mirrored storage & recovery runbooks.

Frequently Asked Question's

  • Can you model our unique rules & approvals?

    Yes—OT slabs, late/early thresholds, no-pay logic, and multi-level approvals by department/site/grade.

  • Is Sri Lanka compliance covered (EPF/ETF/APIT, stamp duty)?

    Yes—calculations, bilingual payslips, bank files, statutory bundles.

  • Which biometric devices/attendance methods are supported?

    Common fingerprint/face devices, web/remote clock-ins, CSV/Excel imports.

  • How long to go live?

    Many SMEs launch in 3-6 weeks (rules/data determine pace).

  • Can we migrate mid-year with balances/history?

    Yes—masters, YTD, leave balances, historical movements.

  • What if policies change later?

    Config change log; many settings self-service; larger shifts under SLA.

  • Will finance get month-end outputs as needed?

    Yes—period locking, variance & reconciliation sheets, packs (PDF/XLS/CSV), scheduled emails.

  • Is data secure and backed up?

    RBAC, audit trails, encryption, daily backups; optional IP/2FA.

  • Do you train the team and support after go-live?

    Role-based training + L1/L2/L3 support; 30-60-90 day tune-ups.

  • How do we start and what will it cost?

    Begin with a Free Fit-Assessment; proposal by employee count, modules and support level.
